categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong QW SOLAR Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: photovoltaic (PV) new energy and low-carbon, environmentally friendly polymer materials. The PV segment focuses on high-efficiency heterojunction (HJT) solar cells and modules, perovskite/silicon tandem cells, EPC contracting, and power station operation and maintenance. The polymer materials segment produces EVA and TPR environmentally friendly modified materials and modified engineering plastics, serving various industries including automotive and electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced photovoltaic technologies such as high-efficiency heterojunction (HJT) solar cells, 0BB (zero busbar) technology, silver-coated copper paste, light conversion films, and perovskite tandem cells. Production methods include integrated product development, plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD) for polysilicon, and automated manufacturing lines in its Shandong and Anhui production bases. The polymer materials segment uses proprietary formulations and continuous R&D to develop environmentally friendly modified plastics with certifications for high performance and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are concentrated and distributed solar power station operators, including commercial and industrial rooftop and large-scale ground-mounted PV projects, both domestic and international. The polymer materials serve clients in automotive parts, household appliances, smart home, electronic tools, and IT sectors. The company also serves downstream PV system integrators and EPC contractors, with key customers including energy companies and supply chain management firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shandong (Zaozhuang) and Anhui (Sixian). Sales cover domestic markets predominantly, with about 15% of revenue from exports to over 38 countries. The company is expanding its presence in international markets and participates in global PV industry associations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong QW SOLAR Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on manufacturing high-efficiency solar cells and modules, EPC contracting, and power station operation services. It procures raw materials such as polysilicon wafers and battery cells from upstream suppliers and sells finished PV modules to downstream power plant operators and distributors. The polymer materials business is positioned as a manufacturer supplying modified plastics to various industrial customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing heterojunction (HJT) solar cell technology and perovskite tandem cells to improve efficiency and reduce costs. R&D priorities include silver-coated copper paste, zero busbar (0BB) technology, light conversion films, and composite frame materials for marine PV applications. It also emphasizes digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to enhance competitiveness. The polymer materials segment focuses on developing environmentally friendly, high-performance modified plastics with applications in emerging industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of photovoltaic modules and components, including high-efficiency HJT solar cells and modules. The company also earns income from EPC contracting and operation and maintenance services for solar power stations. The polymer materials segment generates revenue by producing and selling EVA, TPR, and modified engineering plastics to industrial customers. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to power station operators and industrial clients, supplemented by distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading manufacturer of high-efficiency heterojunction (HJT) solar cells and modules in China, competing with other advanced PV technology firms such as LONGi, JinkoSolar, and Trina Solar. It is a member of the China Photovoltaic Industry Association and recognized for innovation in HJT technology. The polymer materials business competes in the specialty plastics market with a focus on environmentally friendly products. The company is actively optimizing its asset structure to focus on core PV business and improve operational efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 222 million, a significant decrease of about 81% compared to 2023, primarily due to divestment of non-core businesses. The PV segment revenue increased by 60% year-over-year, reflecting growth in the core business. The company has experienced consecutive years of net losses, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 118.6 million in 2024. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 873 million, with ongoing investments in production capacity expansion. The company is undergoing strategic transformation focusing on PV new energy and digitalization to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological innovation in high-efficiency heterojunction (HJT) solar cells and modules, offering products with higher power output, lower degradation, and better temperature coefficients compared to traditional PERC cells. Its 'Quanyao' and 'Tiger Whale' series provide differentiated solutions for land-based and marine PV applications, respectively, with superior mechanical and environmental resistance. The polymer materials segment offers customized, environmentally friendly modified plastics with patented formulations, catering to high-end manufacturing needs. The company also provides integrated EPC and O&M services, positioning itself as a comprehensive clean energy solutions provider.
